# OpenFurqan

> A free web app for reading, studying, memorizing, and listening to the Quran — no account, no ads, no payment.

Website: https://openfurqan.com

## About

OpenFurqan is a free, open-source web application that combines Quran reading, deep study, memorization, and audio recitation in a single fast interface. Most Quran websites focus only on reading. OpenFurqan was built to end the tab-switching between reading, word analysis, Tafsir, and memorization tools. No account required — all data stays in your browser.

## What Makes It Different

- No login, no account, no sign-up required
- No ads, no tracking, no data collection
- Reader + study workflow in one place (no tab-switching)
- Anki-style spaced repetition for Quran memorization
- Word-level Arabic study with Lane's Lexicon and root analysis
- Three reading views: Surah, Juz (all 30), and Mushaf Page (all 604)
- Fast, offline-capable Progressive Web App

## Content

- 114 Surahs (chapters) of the Holy Quran
- 6,236 Ayahs (verses) with full Arabic text
- 20+ translations across 9+ languages
- Word-by-word Arabic analysis with root dictionary

## Translations

English: Sahih International, Yusuf Ali, Pickthall, Arberry, Haleem, Muhsin Khan, Taqi Usmani, Ahmed Raza, Maarif-ul-Quran, Transliteration
Bangla: Muhiuddin Khan, Zohurul Hoque
Urdu: Bayan-ul-Quran, Kanz al-Iman
German: Bubenheim
Spanish: Cortes
French: Hamidullah
Hindi: Al-Umari
Turkish: Suleyman Ates
Sinhala: Naseem Ismail

## Audio Reciters (16)

Mishary Rashid Alafasy, Abdurrahman As-Sudais, Saud Ash-Shuraym, Abu Bakr Ash-Shaatree, Maher Al-Muaiqly, Hani Rifai, Abdul Basit (Murattal), Abdul Basit (Mujawwad), Mahmoud Khalil Al-Husary, Al-Husary (Muallim), Mohamed Siddiq Al-Minshawi, Saad Al-Ghamdi, Ahmed ibn Ali al-Ajmy, Abdullah Ali Jabir, Khalifah Al Tunaiji, Yasser Ad-Dussary. Adjustable playback speed and continuous surah playback.

## Features

Reading:
- Clean, distraction-free Quran reader
- Three reading views: Surah, Juz (para), and Mushaf Page
- Multiple translations side by side
- Audio recitation from 16 reciters with adjustable speed
- 4 themes (Dark, Parchment, Black & White, Dark B&W)
- 4 Arabic fonts, Uthmani/Naskh script, adjustable text sizes
- Reading position saved per surah, juz, and page
- Offline PWA support — installable on any device

Study:
- Word-by-word Arabic meanings, root analysis, and Lane's Lexicon definitions
- 15+ color-coded Tajweed pronunciation rules with legend
- 7+ Tafsir editions on demand (Maarif-ul-Quran, Maududi, Al-Jalalayn, etc.)
- Bookmarks, personal notes per ayah, and reading plans
- Advanced search with key verses, topic groups, and recent history
- Reading statistics: daily verses, time spent, streaks, and history
- Full keyboard shortcuts

Memorization:
- Anki-style spaced repetition (SRS) with flashcards and ratings (Again/Hard/Good/Easy)
- Audio autoplay on cards, session stats, streak tracking, session sharing
- Hifz repetition mode with audio loops and ayah range selection
- Memorization progress tracked across surahs

Other:
- Prayer times for 31+ countries with 11+ calculation methods
- No account required — all data stored locally in browser
- No ads, no tracking, no data collection

## Data Sources

All Quranic text, translations, audio recitations, and linguistic data are sourced from well-established, widely trusted Islamic and academic datasets. Every piece of data has been carefully cross-checked, analyzed, and verified for accuracy before inclusion.

## Privacy

No accounts, no tracking pixels, no analytics cookies, no third-party data collection. All user data (bookmarks, notes, progress, memorization) is stored in browser localStorage. Nothing leaves the device.

## URL Structure

- Homepage: https://openfurqan.com
- Study Mode: https://openfurqan.com/?mode=study
- Surah page: https://openfurqan.com/surah/{surah-slug}
- Ayah page: https://openfurqan.com/surah/{surah-slug}/{ayah-number}
- Memorization: https://openfurqan.com/memorization
